# step enacts procedure

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:stepEnactsProcedure`](gmeow-stepEnactsProcedure.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/stepEnactsProcedure>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/procedures`](../../slices/procedures.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a [`ProcedureStep`](../classes/gmeow-ProcedureStep.md) to the subprocess [`Procedure`](../classes/gmeow-Procedure.md) it enacts. Used when a step is a subprocess ([`gmeow:stepTypeSubprocess`](../individuals/gmeow-stepTypeSubprocess.md)): the step references the [`Procedure`](../classes/gmeow-Procedure.md) that defines its internal steps. Non-functional: a step may reference multiple procedure variants.
